Name: Sprite and Nyapu Portrait retexture for Luo for the 'They Stay With You' Mod
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This is a mod that just adds a new sprite and Nyapu style portrait for Luo from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30989?tab=description&jump_to_comment=149315933]They Stay With You[/url]﻿. It replaces the original images in the mod.

You can find the English translation here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31353]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31353[/url]. Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/201708866]plasmoasis[/url] for making the patch.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This replaces the original mod's images:
 [list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod.
[*]Drag and drop this into your mods folder (it has the same folder name structure as the original mod)
[*]There will be a pop-up asking if you'd like to replace some files - click yes
[*]You're all done!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/200425748]Luo7710[/url] for giving me permission to make this retexture

Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu/mods?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url]﻿ for open asset use permissions in order to make this mod possible: Checkout out their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Portraits[/url]﻿!

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]

Downloads.Description: Just drag and drop over the original mod and it will replace the .pngs from the original.

OPTIONAL: This only includes Luo Sprite in the original style white dress - check images tab for reference.

This is for mods that add new portraits for Luo that has a white dress (e.g. the Shie style Luo Portrait).
